model.name: Truth-decay / no-freshness-invariant family — no authoritative artifact may be stored-and-silent (derive OR revalidate+visible-stale)
model.description: An artifact EXISTS, LOOKS AUTHORITATIVE, and NOTHING keeps it TRUE/ACTIONABLE at read — a stored value or constraint with no invariant re-checking it against the reality it claims. It does not fail loud; it silently misleads and is still trusted. This is the FAMILY (>=8 measured specimens in one day, incl the design-note's own author and the PO), not N instance-fixes. The by-construction CURE, per artifact-class in priority order: (a) DERIVE-first from the single source on each read (no stored copy to rot); ELSE (b) STORED with provenance RE-VALIDATED PER READ + rendered VISIBLY STALE on failure; NEVER (c) stored-and-silent. Each class's cure is FAILABLE (R40.54): a lint/gate that RENDERS-STALE or REDs with a stub-must-fail. Per-instance fixes (R40.55 boot currency+state-removal, fact-2 derived-slot) CITE this as their family root, not duplicate.

discoverySource.corpus: >=8 specimens in one day: deploy-instruction(DEPLOY-STATE.md) / req-satisfaction(R40.50 untasked) / guard-coverage(T40.1 CURED proof) / boot-state(R40.55) / derived-slot(fact-2 46c68e1fc) / circular-ruling(PO deadlock) / relayed-measurement author-#7 + PO-#8 — pervasive enough to catch the design-note author + the PO.

model.crossRefNote: Rides the R40.54 failable-AC family: truth-decay IS the 'unenforced-wish' generalized from a single AC to over-time/at-read across artifact classes. R40.55 (boot) + R40.44 (explicit-wins-while-valid + observable-expiry) + R37.12 (revalidate-or-stale-badge) are per-class instances of cure (b). The enumerate-not-universal + class-divergence + self-application (a hand class-list rots like its artifacts) reuse the R40.55 owner-list lesson.

acceptanceCriteria.text: NO artifact CLASS that reads as AUTHORITATIVE may store its value STORED-AND-SILENT (a stored authoritative value with no re-check). One of two MUST hold, in priority: (a) DERIVE-first — the artifact derives from its single source on each read, no stored copy to rot (failure mode structurally impossible); ELSE (b) STORED-with-revalidation + VISIBLE-STALE — provenance RE-VALIDATED PER READ, renders VISIBLY STALE on failure. Silence (c) IS the entire family and is forbidden.

gateRef.assertion: every authoritative-artifact class resolves to (a) derive-first OR (b) stored+revalidated+visible-stale; any class stored-and-silent => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): seed an authoritative class stored with no re-check (stored-and-silent) => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: DERIVE-first (a) is the REQUIRED cure wherever derivation is possible; STORED-with-revalidation (b) is admissible ONLY when derivation is genuinely impossible and the artifact MUST be stored. A class that stores+revalidates where it could instead derive is a WEAKER cure than available => flagged (prefer-derive).

gateRef.assertion: a class using (b) where (a) is feasible => flagged; (b) with no revalidation OR no visible-stale => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): seed a derivable class that stores+revalidates instead => flagged; a (b) class missing visible-stale => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: deploy-instruction (DEPLOY-STATE.md): (a) DERIVE the instruction from BRANCH REALITY (branch-contains + main..HEAD), OR (b) stamp it with the commit-range it was true for + render STALE when HEAD moves past that range. A stored 'do NOT merge/DELETE branch' with no re-check against branch state (14 hotfix commits incl shipped v0.8.143) => the pure specimen.

gateRef.assertion: HEAD past the instruction's stated commit-range => VISIBLE STALE banner (not silent); or the instruction derives from branch-contains

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): seed a deploy-instruction whose stated range HEAD has passed => VISIBLE STALE (stub-must-fail: silent => RED)

acceptanceCriteria.text: req-satisfaction: (a) DERIVE 'satisfied' from a tracked COVERING TASK's state — NEVER store 'satisfied' as an authored flag. An AC with tasks[]==empty is UN-SATISFIABLE-BY-CONSTRUCTION (rides R40.54 failable family + the untasked-AC audit). Specimen: R40.50 4c4de905 had 7 ACs / tasks[]=empty, shipped falsely-satisfied v0.8.118 then reopened.

gateRef.assertion: an AC-bearing req with tasks[]==empty => RED; satisfaction derives from a covering Task's state, never an authored flag

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): seed an AC-bearing req with tasks[]==empty => RED (untasked-AC audit, tier-1 made strict)

acceptanceCriteria.text: guard-coverage: (a) coverage DERIVES from the guard being IN ci:gates + the substep present — never an assertion that a guard 'is wired' with nothing checking it. gateRef.assertion: a guard claimed as coverage but absent from ci:gates (or its substep absent) => RED; coverage derives from presence-in-gates

A hand-maintained class list rots exactly like the artifacts it polices (self-application, R40.55 owner-list lesson).

acceptanceCriteria.text: A RELAYED MEASUREMENT (a peer's line-numbers/counts/'X absent-or-present') is itself a STORED artifact timestamped at THEIR read, not yours — it decays. It MUST be RE-DERIVED at point-of-use before being asserted as current, ESPECIALLY into a durable artifact or a report. Specimens #7 (author cited a peer's stale DEPLOY-STATE read) + #8 (PO escalated a wrong-name resolveChangeRequest grep=0 to Tron 3x). Enforcement is process-failable: a durable claim citing a measurement must carry its own point-of-use re-derivation or be marked RELAYED-UNVERIFIED.

gateRef.assertion: a durable claim asserting a measurement with no point-of-use re-derivation and not marked RELAYED-UNVERIFIED => flagged

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): seed a durable report asserting a relayed count as current with no re-derivation => flagged

acceptanceCriteria.text: The family cure is REAL only if it can FAIL: each artifact-class gets a lint/gate that RENDERS-STALE or REDs when its invariant breaks, WITH a stub-must-fail (a seeded broken artifact of that class observed RED before the gate counts as wired). Generalizes R40.54 evidence-must-fail from a single AC to the whole family. A class whose gate has never been shown RED on its own defect = UNPROVEN.

gateRef.assertion: each per-class gate has a registered RED observation on its own defect; a green-only (never-RED) class gate => UNPROVEN/RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): each class stub seeded with its defect must be observed RED before that class counts cured
